purpose: Test the bounded-local-update policy at fixed rounds and matched aggregate optimizer updates
primary_comparison: Final full-validation metrics at matched aggregate optimizer steps, within each partition lane
secondary_comparison: Round 20 metrics from each run, including the existing prefix of each longer capped run
best_checkpoint_metrics: Descriptive only; unequal validation opportunities must not select the comparison endpoint
stopping_policy: Fixed schedule, no early stopping or automatic extension
aggregation: Original partition-size weights; all clients participate in every round including the shorter final round
sampling: Fresh seeded permutation each client-round; only capped prefix is used, no guaranteed full data coverage
limitations: Aggregate updates match within each lane, not per-client updates, examples, wall time, validation work or communication
Capped training redistributes local update counts across clients and resets Adam more frequently
This is a combined training-policy intervention, not proof of a pure client-drift mechanism
Single training seed and partition seed; confirmation requires additional predefined seeds
No test evaluation and no 2M/5M scaling authorization
gates: Commit a reviewed snapshot and transfer it without overwriting old cloud outputs
Run CPU fixture tests on the cloud environment
Run official_bounded_recovery on CUDA and inspect checks.json before proceeding
Run same-code full-epoch bridges and compare model tensors and non-timing history with archived LayerNorm reference, allowing only documented new history fields
Verify bridge counts, data and assignment hashes before launching capped runs
If any gate fails, stop rather than relaxing checks or changing settings
